## Core Technical Skills

- **Agentic AI & Orchestration:** Model Context Protocol (MCP), Multi-Agent Orchestration (Agent-to-Agent / A2A), OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, Multi-Agent Systems & Hierarchical Architectures, Tool/Function Calling, Structured Outputs (Pydantic)

- **Backend & Distributed Systems:** Python, FastAPI, Node.js, WebSockets, gRPC & Protocol Buffers, REST APIs
- **Databases & State Management:** PostgreSQL (Neon, Aurora), Amazon DocumentDB, SQL
- **Cloud, Serverless & DevOps:** AWS (Lambda, EKS, API Gateway, S3, CloudWatch), Docker, Argo CD, Jenkins, Linux, Langfuse
- **Frontend & Desktop:** TypeScript, React, Next.js, Electron.js, Web Components (Shadow DOM), Tailwind CSS, OAuth2 + PKCE

## Work Experience

### ProductSquads | Ahmedabad, India
**Associate AI Engineer** (November 2025 – Present)
- Maintained an OpenSearch Serverless hybrid RAG pipeline (Matryoshka embeddings, Sentence-Window retrieval) over 400M+ documents, sustaining 16ms keyword and 43ms vector p50 latency across ~50K-70K daily queries (~2M+ monthly).
- Operated AWS Lambda MCP services handling 45K+ monthly tool calls across 60+ tables and 700+ fields via allowlisted schema registries and injected tenant ACL joins.
- Eliminated midstream answer loss across 100K+ messages by moving chat history persistence and title generation from the browser to Python BFF Lambdas and Amazon DocumentDB.
- Rearchitected multi-turn prompt clarification from browser state to a server-driven state machine (Python BFF and DocumentDB), unblocking SME testing on schedule and preventing state corruption on client disconnects.
- Eliminated peak-hour missed prompt runs by diagnosing a rush-hour queue bottleneck and splitting discovery checkers and execution jobs into separate dedicated queues.
- Built a multi-agent release verification system demoed directly to the CTO that automated 90%+ of release checks, cutting triage from 20+ minutes to <30 seconds and catching unhardened ECS tasks.

### Meru Technosoft | Ahmedabad, India
**Full-Stack Intern** (June 2025 – July 2025)
- Built a cross-platform Electron/TypeScript desktop sync runner that queried on-premise Tally instances via local HTTP/XML and synced data to cloud databases, eliminating manual CSV exports across 2 pilot clients.
- Engineered a Node.js gRPC and Protocol Buffers microservice to stream desktop payloads, parse Tally XML schemas, and persist normalized accounting ledgers into PostgreSQL.
- Implemented OAuth2 with PKCE in the API Gateway using custom OS deep-link callbacks, enabling browser-based desktop login without hardcoding API secrets in the client binary.
- Automated Jenkins CI/CD release pipelines to compile desktop installers, run Windows executable code signing, and publish versioned artifacts to AWS S3 for twice-weekly client deployments.
